[LSER.8.8.1] Reading an aggregation is **read-only**: evaluating
`mean(t)`, `p95(t)`, `active_fraction(t)`, etc. computes the value
as of the query clock from stored backing state and never mutates
that state. The only state mutation is sample absorption, which
runs once per pump after the agenda drains ([LSER.8.6]);
eviction and compaction happen on assertion, never on a read.
